s: Bor ubeer shebben shette chatzerot ubo d' seipim: bor shebben b' chatzerot veen benehen petach o challon sheyyukelu leareb, o sheyyesh benehen velo erebu — en memallein mimmennu beshabbat, shehare reshut shenehen sholetet sham, ella im ken asu lo mechitztza asara tepachim lemala min hammayim lehekker haprasha ben reshut zo lezo, shebbimchitztza zo omerim "gud achet" lematta ad qarqait habbor, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"h, hoil veyesh bah hekker vezikkaron shello yabou letaltel mechatzer lechatzer bemaqom acher shello bimqom milluy mayim, shebbemayim bilbad heqellu lomar "gud achet" mittaam shennitbaer sham. Abal kotel hechatzer shemmehallek al gabbe habbor eno niddon mishshum mechitztza, lepi sheen bo hekker kelal, hoil velo naasa bishbil kak. Veim hammechitztza hi kullah betok hammayim — tzarik sheyyehe tepach yotze mimmenna lemala min hammayim kede shettehe hahaprasha benehen nikkeret. Veim hi kulla lemala min hammayim — tzarik sheyyehe tepach mimmenna meshuqqa bammayim, limnoa haddeli millelek velachtzob mayim mereshut chabero. Veap sheggam akshav holek haddeli mittachat hammechitztza lirshut chabero — en bekak kelum, sheqqal hu sheheqellu chakamim bemayim shello lehatzrik bahem mechitztza gemura lehabdil ben mayim lemayim legamre, ella sheyyehe nireh kemubdalim, velo yehe nireh shezzeh doleh mereshut chabero ella keillu kol echad doleh mereshuto. Veken im hinnichu al pene habbor qora rechaba d' tepachim — zeh memalle mitztzad zeh vezeh memalle mitztzad zeh, sheheqellu bemayim lomar "pi tiqra yored vesotem" mishte ruchoteha, ukeillu pi hattiqra hu mechitztza yoredet ad qarqait habbor. Vekan en lachush sheyyehe nireh shezzeh doleh mereshut chabero, lepi sheshshiaru chakamim sheen deli mehallek yoter mid' tepachim, veim ken lo yachtzob mayim mitztzad hab' shel haqqora shehu reshut chabero. Veap shechotzeb mittachat haqqora, vesham reshut shenehem sholetet — en bekak kelum, sheheqellu chakamim bemayim velo chasheshu ella shello yachtzob haddeli mitztzad hab', sheaz nireh laayin shechotzeb mereshut chabero. Mah sheen ken tachat haqqora eno nikkar kol kak shershut chabero sholetet sham, veen nireh kechotzeb mereshut chabero. Veken heqellu bemayim velo chasheshu mah shehammayim mitorbim veholekim mitztzad zeh shel hammechitztza o haqqora letzad hab', vehalla doleh otam sham. Vekol zeh lemallot hammayim ulehaknisam labbayit, o apillu yishtammesh bahem bechatzer ella sheddoleh bidli sheshshabat babbayit. Abal im shabat bechatzer — en tzarik shum tiqqun labbor lemallot mimmennu lachatzerot, shehare kol hachatzerot reshut echad hen lekelim sheshshabetu betokan, ap al pi shello erebu, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"b:

Veim en habbor qarob leb' hachatzerot ella rachoq mikkol echad d' tepachim, kegon sheyyesh shebil qatan ben kotle b' chatzerot vehabbor betoko, im en shum chatzer petucha lo bepetach gamur ella memallein mimmenna derek challonot happetuchim lo mishte hachatzerot, im yesh min hachallonot lemayim y' tepachim, shettashmish milluy zeh hu tashmish beqoshi — shenehem muttarim lemallot mimmennu beshabbat, veenan oserim zeh al zeh apillu hu shel shenehem beshuttaput, kevan sheenan mishtammeshim bo ella bizriqat haddeli baavir berochab d' tepachim, veen adam oser al avir chabero derek shehu berochab d' tepachim, lepi sheen zeh chashub tashmish kelal, veeno keday leesor al chabero ella im ken hu betok asara, ayyen simman sha"h. Abal im chatzerot petuchot lashshebil — reshut shenehem sholetet bo vahare hu kechatzer shel shenehem, vaasurim bo ad sheyyearebu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehashshebil hu reshut hayyachid. Abal im hu karmelit, kegon shemmepullash bishne rashayv lekarmelit — apillu im habbor muplag mikkotle hachatzerot d' tepachim asur lemallot mimmennu, ella im ken maqqipato chulya gaboah asara, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh[n]"d:

Shette chatzerot ubenehen g' churbot sheen baalehen darin bahen, umuqqapot mechitztzot hen mikkol ruchotehen vahare hen reshut hayyachid gemura, ella shehen perutzot zo lezo (bemilluan o beyoter meeser ammot), veyesh lekol achat mehachatzerot challonot petuchim lechurba sheetzlah — hare kol echad muttar beotah sheetzlah lehishtammesh bah derek challono al yede shilshul uzeriqa; hoil veen lo bah tashmish gamur bechol, sheen lo petach patuach lah ella challon, en pirtzat hammechitztza oseret. Umuttar lehishtammesh bekulla, vachabero eno oserah alayv. Veap al pi sheggam chabero mishtammesh bah bechol, shezzoreq derek avir shello bappirtza ad tok churba zo, mikkol maqom kevan shellachabero en lo bah ella al yede zeriqa baavir berochab d' tepachim veyoter — eno yakol leosrah alayv, venotenim otah lo, sheyyesh lo bah tashmish noach beshilshul samuk lechallono. Veen chabero yakol lehishtammesh bah beshabbat al yede zeriqa baavir, mippene shehu oserah al chabero. Abal churba haemtzait, kevan shehi rechoqa mishshenehem veen lishnehem bah ella tashmish al yede zeriqa baavir berochab d' tepachim — enan oserim zeh al zeh ushenehem muttarim bah beshabbat, ap al pi shello erebu yachad. Veim sheloshtan semukot labbattim, kegon shehaemtzait hi keneged hashtayim keg' ragle haqqanqan — kol echad muttar bechurba sheetzlo, vehashshelishit haqqeroba lishnehem shenehem asurim bah, lepi sheyyesh lishnehem bah tashmish noach beshilshul samuk lachallon, veoserim zeh al zeh. Vechurbot ellu, ap al pi sheyyesh lahem bealim, muttarim bene chatzerot hassemukot lahen lehishtammesh bahen veen habbealim oserim alehen, hoil veenan darim bahem, vedira belo bealim enah oseret, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"a:

Bet hakkisse shebben b' battim vekol echad nipneh lo mibbeto, o apillu omed ben b' chatzerot vekol echad nipneh lo mechatzero, im hu shel shenehem beshuttaput velo erebu yachad — asurim lippanot lo lekattechilla beshabbat, lepi shehu kechatzer shel shenehem, vehatztzoa hi kekelim sheshshabetu babbayit, veasur lehotziam apillu mechatzer lechatzer ad sheyyearebu yachad o yaasu lo tiqqun:
